translation.name: Nzuwulai n Sa'avu na̱ Tsishingini na̱ a̱ɗiva̱ a na a ɗangulai a Nzuwulai mu Ufaru

book.name: 2 Korinti
book.title: Mepepelime me Ire ma̱ Bulu a̱ tyo ya̱ A̱za̱ a̱ Korinti

content: Tsu fara ta̱ uꞌya̱sa̱sa̱n wa avangaci adama a aciya̱tsu waru? Ama a̱ ta̱ ta̱wusa̱ na̱ mpepelime n na a ɗanai n na maa yuwusan adanshi e ica a aciyele ko gba shi a ta zuwusa ɗu i ɗanaa le mpepelime adama e le. U tu ulobonu tsu da̱na̱i ni icuꞌun yi mpepelime n nda?
Amma a̱ɗu ɗa mepepelime ma̱ tsu, waru i ta̱ o okolo a̱ tsu na vuma suru ee ɗenuna̱ a̱vu u reve ili i na e ɗeyinuna̱.

I to rocosu a̱ɗu mepepelime ma na Zamawawa ɗanai ɗa, a̱vu a̱tsu tsu ta̱wa̱ na̱ a̱yi. Ruhu va̱ A̱sula̱ za na aa casu wuma, u ɗana ɗu ta̱ o okolo a̱ tsu, agba a̱ a̱a̱vuꞌun shi, ko e ili yi iɗana i na a yuwain na aɓaci a atali shi.
Tsu ta damma ne adama o ucawu wo okolo a̱ tsu o ucira a̱ ma̱ka̱ka̱n ma̱ A̱sula̱ adama a Zamawawa.
Amma tsa dansa tsu ta gura yuwan ulinga u nda na aciya̱tsu shi. A̱sula̱ a ɗa a zuwusa tsu tsu gura yuwan ili i na tsaa yuwusan suru.

U zuwa tsu ta̱ tso oꞌwo agbashi a akucunu a saꞌavu a̱ yi na o utusa̱ uba̱ta̱ wa̱ Ruhu va Akiza. Akucunu a nda Wila̱ u na a ɗanai ɗa shi, adama a na Wila̱ u tsu ta̱wa̱a̱ ta̱ nu ukwa̱, amma Ruhu tsu ca ta̱ wuma.

Akuci a̱ Wila̱ a ɗana le ta̱ a atali, reve gba e ene tsugbain tsa̱ A̱sula̱ a mantsaꞌa. Ama a Israꞌila a gura jima a̱ ka̱lyuwusa̱ urewesu wa Musa shi, adama a na u shi te ikanasa nu ucira lon, ko na wo oꞌwoi wikanasaꞌa tsa jima shi. Adama o ndolo, na̱ Wila̱ za na ulinga wa̱ yi a̱yi ɗa u ta̱wa̱a̱ nu ukwa̱ u shi na̱ tsugbain ne tsundolo,
to, ulinga wa̱ Ruhu va̱ A̱sula̱ u ta̱ da̱na̱ na̱ tsugbain tsa na tsa laꞌai za Wila̱. Amayun a ɗa shi?
Nu ulinga u na u tsu kototo ama u shi na̱ tsugbain, to, ulinga u na u tsu ka̱mba̱to ama mejege e ekere a̱ A̱sula̱ u ta̱ da̱na̱ na̱ tsugbain tsa na tsa laꞌai.
Amayun a ɗa tsugbain tsa akuci tsa akucunu u tsu rotso tsugbain waru shi, adama a na ekan a tsugbain tsa saꞌavu tsa laꞌa yi ta̱.
Wila̱ u shi ta̱ na̱ tsugbain tsa na tso kporoi. Amma tsugbain tsa akucunu a saꞌavu u laꞌa yi ta̱ lon, adama a na woo kporo shi, ko keꞌen.
Tsu ta gura yuwan adanshi babu wovon adama a na tsu ri nu uzuwu wo okolo ne tsunda.
Tsu ri tsa Musa shi. Urewesu wa̱ yi u shi te ikanasa, reve wu pala urewesuꞌu adama u geshe aza a Israꞌila e ene ekan o ukporuso wan.
Amaꞌa a̱ shi ta̱ na aciyogbamu, ili i ro waru i ta putsusa le na ee ene amayun a mantsa ma na e ɗesu Wila̱ nu una̱. Yesu Zamawawa ɗa goon a gura tawa apalutsu a na aa putsusa le yeni.
Hali na anaꞌan, ne ee ɗesu Wila̱ wa Musa nu una̱, aapalutsu a pala ta̱ okolo e le.
Agba na̱ vuma vadala† uba̱ta̱ wu Zagbain (Yesu), u tsu tawa ta̱ aapalutsu o ndoloꞌo.
Ana wo oꞌwoi Zagbain Ruhu ɗa, uba̱ta̱ u na Ruhu vu Zagbain ri suru, u tsu zuwa ta̱ ama o oꞌwo fa̱a̱n.

Adama o ndolo a ɗa urewesu u tsu u ri ukpa̱tuꞌu adama tsu roco tsugbain tsa̱ A̱sulazuva. Waru na̱ Ruhu va̱ A̱sulazuva ri o ulinga a̱tsuma̱ a̱ tsu, tsu ta̱ ka̱mbusa̱ tsa̱ yi kuci, waru tsu ta̱ da̱shi rocosu tsugbain tsa̱ yi.
